note: Coordinates are planetocentric lat/lon (east-positive) as recalled from the USGS Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature / Wikipedia. They were NOT re-checked against the Gazetteer by the pipeline author: verify each before trusting results (see README).
sha256_note: Trust-on-first-use pins: computed from the files as first downloaded on 2026-10-30 (the sources publish no checksums). A mismatch means the file changed upstream or was tampered with; fetch deletes it.

sites.name: Shackleton
sites.coord_note: Gazetteer gives 89.9S 0E, which lies on the rim next to the pole; the floor is not there. Centre here = centroid of Diviner annual-max <110 K pixels within 15 km of the pole (checked: also near the deepest LOLA DEM point, -89.63 / 118.8E). Verify against a published crater centre.

published_ice_evidence.note: Water ice detected in the ejecta plume of the LCROSS impact in Cabeus.
published_ice_evidence.citation: Colaprete, A. et al. (2010) Detection of water in the LCROSS ejecta plume. Science 330, 463-468. doi:10.1126/science.1186986

published_pending_user_verification: LCROSS water abundance in the Cabeus plume (I recall about 5.6 +/- 2.9 wt%) - not stored until you confirm in Colaprete et al. 2010.

Li et al. 2018 PNAS 115, 8907 (doi:10.1073/pnas.1802345115), M3 surface-ice detections in polar shadowed regions - which of these seven craters host a detection must be read from the paper's table; none stored.

rover.note: Planning grid = 4 x 80 m = 320 m cells using the block-maximum slope (conservative). Slope above max_slope_deg is impassable; steeper ground costs more. These limits are illustrative, not a specific rover's spec.
